references.context: There exist rational delta>0 and N with all a_n at or after N bounded below by delta.
Equivalent Cauchy sequence b_n has sufficiently small difference to a_n so b_n eventually >=delta/2.
Order positivity is specified by Cauchy-class representatives and rational margin, not by termwise positivity alone.

references.phrase: eventual margin stronger than eventually positive entries
references.disposition: A sequence may be eventually positive yet tend to zero, so no fixed positive delta need exist.

review_rationale: Reviewed positivity of a Cauchy-equivalence class via eventual positive rational lower bound, with representative independence using half-margin estimate.
